title: Search envelope
description: What a bank search returns, locally from tools/bank_search.py and from the production route alike. The caller sends a need (need.schema.json) and gets question sets back, ranked, with the state of every arm. The product repo pins this file and tests its client against it; a field is added here first and in the client second. Version 1 is the local search's shape today plus the fields the route adds (source, credit, enrichment, content_hash, media) so that one shape serves both.

need.description: The need as the search understood it, echoed so a caller can show it back while the rows load

arm.description: The arm that answered (A, A1, B, B1, C, C2)

stage.description: A caller that streams gets `first` (vector order, ids and titles) then `final` (reranked, full rows); a single answer is `final`

timing_ms.description: Server-side stage times in milliseconds, so the latency budget can be checked per call

best_view.description: The index view the vector hit came from: title, samples, meaning_pl, meaning_en, needs

source.description: Where the set's questions come from: khan, own, ai

credit.description: The attribution line the product must show: Khan Academy, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and the exercise's URL

enrichment.description: The set's enrichment fields the caller may show, each the set page's value with its made_by and reviewed wrapper removed (service/rows.py ENRICHMENT_SHOWN; shapes from set.schema.json): summary and can_do by language, mistake_classes as records, contexts as word lists by language. Any other key is a private field and never leaves the service.

spot.description: How the mistake shows in one answer

content_hash.description: sha256 of the set page the row was built from, so a cached row can be checked against the bank

media.description: shas of the pictures the set's items need

items.description: How many items the set holds

state.description: One row per known arm: the asked arm's outcome and not_asked for the rest

detail.description: What degraded it (an embedder or reranker failure), never a key or a URL with a token

bank_rev.description: sha256 of the index manifest the service answered from; the publisher writes it with the rows, so a caller can tell which build of the bank a row came from
